title: Zeus ArcPods Lid Pack
description:
Each pack contains 50 Zeus ArcPod Lids

The ArcPods Lid pack is essential for any frequent Zeus Arcpods user. Its important to mention that you cannot use a ArcPod without a lid. And although the pods are reusable, the paper lids are one time use.

One time use Lids for Zeus ArcPods
Food Safe
Lids for Dry Herb ArcPods

Compatibility:
Zeus Arc GT3
Zeus Arc GTS
Zeus Arc S
Zeus Arc GT
Zeus Arc

Each pack contains:
50x Zeus ArcPod Lid
